environment.description: Tomcat 9.0.68 on Amazon EC2 (m5.large), behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4 only). PostgreSQL 14.6 RDS instance with db.r5.large, connected via private subnet. The database role used by the application (report_app) has SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE grants on all tables in the 'reporting' schema plus pg_catalog read access. No query-level firewall or SQL proxy between application and database. Security groups allow TCP 5432 from application subnet CIDR only.

config.database: PostgreSQL 14.6 RDS, role 'report_app' with full DML on reporting schema
config.network: Private subnet, SG allows 5432 from app subnet
config.db_permissions: GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA reporting TO report_app; GRANT SELECT ON pg_catalog.pg_tables TO report_app;
